summary: # CLO 2025.0 - User Interface Update ## Introduction This video introduces the update regarding the user interface for CLO 2025.0. ## New Library Window After the update to 2025.0, our default library window will be changed to a new library. For more details on using the new library, you can refer to the explanation in the new function introduced in version 2024.2. If you prefer to go back to the old library, you can click the return key to revert to the previous version. ## Collector Function In version 2025.0, we have added the collector function before the transfer. This function will accelerate the transfer of the collector, allowing you to quickly build your own familiar workstation. In the current old library, there is a new collector feature from the 2024.2 version. Now, when you switch back to the new library and click the add button, you will see two options: - Create a new library - The collector before the transfer Choose the collector before the transfer to add it to the new library. ## Resource Manager Integration When you right-click on the collector or file, you will find an additional option: "Display in Resource Manager." This feature helps you quickly locate the path where the file is stored. This operation is also applicable to the old library, allowing you to avoid re-adding all the collectors. In the new library, you can efficiently complete this operation. ## Window Mode Enhancements In the previous version, the window selection card would reset after switching modes, and the UV editor and 2D window could not be displayed simultaneously. This required users to revert to simulation mode to view the 2D window, which was inconvenient during the editing process. In 2025.0, the UV and animation editor will reset from the window mode, allowing you to use other tools or windows without switching modes. The UV editor is now positioned at the top of the menu within the 3D material UV selection card. Just like the animation editor, you can now freely switch to other windows for editing. This function saves additional steps in mode switching, speeding up the editing process. ## Display Settings Since the 2025.0 update, we support display settings in the 3D and 2D vertical menu bar, which are preserved in the project file. Let's take a closer look at this feature. - If the window is a new project, opening the created project will automatically apply its display settings. - If the window has an already opened project, you can select display settings when opening another project to maintain the 3D and 2D vertical menu bar information display or revert to the software's default settings. ### Important Note Display settings are currently only supported in the project file. Files saved in previous versions do not contain these display settings. In subsequent updates, clothing files will also support the selection of this information. ## File Saving and Shrink Chart Settings We hope this function update will significantly reduce errors for file creators and receivers when checking the 3D file effect. After updating to 2025.0, when saving files, do not use the PNG shrink chart from other files. If you want to save the shrink chart, you can set this in the user self-definition settings. 1. In the main menu bar, find "User Self-Definition" at the bottom of the settings. 2. Click on "Default File" to set whether to save the shrink chart at the bottom of the project. The default is not selected. After selecting, a type selection box will pop up, allowing you to choose the type of shrink chart. You can select the current view; the saved shrink chart will mirror the shrink chart from the previous version. ### Multi-View Settings You can select views from the front, back, left, and four views to obtain a multi-view display. Please note that the view will automatically adjust to adapt to the clothing itself and will not include models. Therefore, if you choose this option, it is recommended to hide the model. After selecting the self-definition view, you can open the multi-view setting file and save the selected options according to the settings. Again, it is advisable to hide the model. If the selection changes to all clothing, when saving, it will be saved as the main body of clothing. This setting allows you to freely choose whether to save and how to save the shrink chart of the project file. We hope this functionality helps you improve your work efficiency!
